posts.zh:
dsh-rate-limiter 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。按 provider 令牌桶主动限速，超限请求在发出前延迟排队而非失败，避免触发上游 429。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1f6218ef5b3f26edc879.html
posts.en:
dsh-rate-limiter is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Proactive per-provider token-bucket rate limiting that queues over-limit requests before they are sent, preventing upstream 429 errors.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1f6218ef5b3f26edc879.html
